page.overview:
Who is Aala (Deity)?

When Kyrie, daughter of Rane the Reaver was found on the shore, she was believed to be Aala by the natives, as she had redhair like Aala.

Kyrie was worshiped as Aala, and learned to use that belief for her own purpose, until high priest Gothan had her exiled and those faithful to her slaughtered.
